audit_findings.title: A $1.584 billion tax claim ahead of common equity is absent from the bridge
audit_findings.magnitude: $1.610 billion excluded from the latest contractual-obligations review; $2.59 per diluted share and 9.3% of base equity value
audit_findings.mechanism: An outstanding tax claim must enter either forecast OE through settlement cash payments or the equity bridge as a liability, but not both.
audit_findings.evidence: Therefore, $1,584 million in long-term income taxes payable has been excluded from the contractual obligations table.
audit_findings.explanation: The liability and its omission from the bridge are demonstrated, but a valuation error is not yet demonstrated because some or all may already be reflected through historical tax charges or forecast cash taxes and offsetting benefits. If the full latest disclosed amount requires a separate deduction, base value falls from $27.90 to approximately $25.31 per share and bull value from $32.76 to approximately $30.17, enough to change the conclusion at the $30.65 market price.
audit_findings.action: Reconcile the $1.610 billion to tax charges embedded in OE, deferred-tax assets, correlative benefits and expected settlement cash flows; rerun with only the portion not already captured in OE deducted or scheduled.

audit_findings.title: The anchor may include a $354 million litigation reversal while a $254 million claim remains
audit_findings.magnitude: $354 million pretax reversal, equal to 29.6% of the $1,195.9 million anchor; latest Columbia accrual $256 million, or $0.41 per diluted share
audit_findings.mechanism: The reversal can inflate anchor OE if treated as recurring, while any unpaid claim not represented in forecast OE may require an equity-bridge deduction.
audit_findings.evidence: At this time, our current estimate of probable losses from this matter, within a range of potential outcomes, is approximately $ 254 million, a reduction of $ 354 million in our fourth quarter of fiscal 2026, which is accrued and recorded as part of Other long-term liabilities in the Consolidated Balance Sheets .
audit_findings.explanation: The $354 million reversal and remaining accrued obligation are filed facts, but inclusion of the reversal in the OE anchor has not been established. Because the reversal is nearly 30% of the anchor, failure to neutralize it would materially overstate every forecast year and terminal value. The separate $256 million accrual is smaller but still ahead of common equity; deducting it without determining whether its expense is already captured would risk double counting.
audit_findings.action: Trace the $354 million reversal through the FY2026 OE worksheet and remove its after-tax OE effect if present; reconcile the latest $256 million accrual to forecast settlement cash flows before applying any bridge deduction.

audit_findings.title: MoneyLion's essential Instacash funding agreement may have expired before the valuation date
audit_findings.magnitude: $0 demonstrated valuation impact; facility extended to July 30, 2028 with a $300 million limit, up to $100 million additional at Sound Point's discretion, and $37 million unused capacity at July 3, 2026
audit_findings.mechanism: The facility affects Instacash funding requirements, loss-on-sale economics and therefore OE and working capital.
audit_findings.evidence: The Purchase Agreement has an initial two-year term beginning on June 30, 2024, with a one-year extension option upon mutual agreement.
audit_findings.explanation: The latest 10-Q resolves the alleged pre-valuation expiration: an amendment extended the scheduled termination date beyond September 5, 2026. The company sold $1.193 billion of advances during the latest quarter under the amended agreement, demonstrating continued operation. Accordingly, the asserted expiration creates no present adjustment relative to the supplied valuation.
audit_findings.action: No current rerun is needed; monitor utilization, pricing, concentration limits and renewal or replacement risk ahead of July 30, 2028.

audit_findings.title: Unreserved NYAG litigation attacks the legality of a material revenue product
audit_findings.magnitude: Instacash revenue of $479 million in FY2026 and $147 million in the latest quarter; potential remediation, penalties and OE loss unquantified
audit_findings.mechanism: An adverse outcome could reduce recurring Instacash OE and growth, increase compliance costs, or create restitution and penalty claims requiring forecast cash outflows or a bridge deduction.
audit_findings.evidence: The complaint alleges, among other things, that MoneyLion’s earned wage access product violates New York’s civil and criminal usury laws and asserts claims of fraud, deceptive, and false advertising practices under state law, as well as abusive and deceptive practices under the federal Consumer Financial Protection Act.
audit_findings.explanation: The pending action and product exposure are demonstrated, while liability and earnings effects remain unresolved because no loss range or Instacash profit contribution is disclosed. Instacash represented 9.6% of FY2026 revenue and 11.0% of latest-quarter revenue. A restriction, prohibition or broader remediation program could therefore affect both the anchor and terminal assumptions enough to change the valuation conclusion.
audit_findings.action: Obtain post-filing case developments, state-by-state revenue and contribution profit, challenged fee and tip economics, potential restitution populations and insurance coverage; rerun OE and growth under product-restriction and remediation scenarios.

audit_findings.title: The perimeter review omitted a second FY2026 acquisition
audit_findings.magnitude: $175 million net purchase consideration, approximately 1.0% of base equity value; full-year OE impact unquantified
audit_findings.mechanism: Only about three weeks of the acquired business entered anchor OE, while its future earnings, amortization, integration costs, funding needs and assumed liabilities affect normalized OE and possibly the bridge.
audit_findings.evidence: On March 10, 2026, we acquired all of the outstanding shares of a technology-enabled company that provides a digital personal insurance marketplace platform in the United States.
audit_findings.explanation: The perimeter omission is demonstrated, but the record does not disclose standalone earnings sufficient to establish a material valuation error. A full year of profitable operations could make the anchor conservative, whereas integration costs, liabilities or weak economics could reduce value. Purchase price alone cannot substitute for recurring OE, although its scale is only about 1% of the base equity valuation.
audit_findings.action: Add the acquisition to the perimeter schedule and obtain standalone historical and post-acquisition revenue, cash earnings, maintenance investment, working-capital requirements, integration costs and assumed liabilities before rerunning normalized OE.

audit_findings.title: The anchor is based on a nonrepeatable 53-week year
audit_findings.magnitude: $87 million additional-week revenue, equal to 1.7% of FY2026 revenue and 7.3% of the OE anchor; incremental OE impact unquantified
audit_findings.mechanism: Any net profit attributable to the extra week inflates the latest-year OE anchor and is then capitalized through all forecast years and terminal value.
audit_findings.evidence: Net revenues also increased $87 million due to the favorable impact from the additional week in the first quarter of fiscal 2026, impacting both segment financials.
audit_findings.explanation: The extra $87 million of revenue is demonstrated, but the related costs, taxes and resulting owner earnings are not supplied. Revenue scale alone cannot establish the valuation adjustment. Because the disclosed revenue equals 7.3% of the anchor before associated expenses, the record also cannot safely conclude that the effect is immaterial.
audit_findings.action: Calculate the additional week's revenue, operating costs, cash taxes and maintenance investment on the OE basis, restate FY2026 to 52 weeks and rerun all scenarios if the existing build did not already normalize it.
